body:
## What changed
No UI, no routes, no content, no migrations.
- `src/features/practice-studio/availability.ts` — pure module. Per year / programme / subject / strand: unique-question count, canonical strand label, `eligible` (>= `STRAND_FLOOR`), median seconds, and state `ready | none | unknown`. Helpers `offeredSetSizes` and `aboutMinutes`.
- `src/server/practice-studio-availability.ts` — `getStudioAvailability()`, feeds the pure module from the served bank, PROGRAMS + `resolveProgramStatuses`, and `getPublicationEligibility()`. Counts only; no question content or keys leave it.
- Tests: 24 unit + 5 real-bank invariant tests.

## Rules applied
- Strand floor = 5, one named constant, documented as a **new** Practice Studio rule (D2); no copy or comment attributes it to the Learning Hub.
- Strand labels normalised at read time only (case, `&`/`and`, word order in an "x and y" pair). `Number`, `Number & Arithmetic`, `Number and algebra` stay separate. Nothing edited.
- Join via `filterEligibleQuestions` so `language` finds `language_conventions`.
- Fail closed: integrity problem, thrown error, or an **empty bank** is `unknown` with `null` counts (not 0, no strands, no set sizes, no time). `none` and `unknown` carry different `reason`s.
- Median of unique questions x set size, rounded to 5 minutes, never below 5, refused if the set exceeds the slice.

## Findings to read
1. **De-dup key deviates from the brief, on purpose.** Prompt text alone gives 17 groups / 68 questions; prompt + stimulus + options + visuals gives **13 / 55**. The 4 groups / 13 questions that differ are generic prompts ("What is the main idea?") over different passages: distinct questions. Collapsing them would shrink a pool wrongly. Easy to revert to prompt-only if you prefer.
2. **Audit correction on AMC.** The audit called AMC "unscoped". On this base the AMC programmes are scoped coming-soon entries (generated from the year registry). They stay coming-soon only because 26/27 questions sit below the catalogue threshold of 30; they would be promoted automatically at 30. The wrapper therefore excludes `amc_style` and `scholarship_style` explicitly (`SURFACED_STYLES`).
3. The catalogue has coming-soon entries for years 2, 4, 6-12. They come through as `none/coming_soon`; P4 should hide them, not render them.
4. Real bank result: 87 programme rows (17 ready, 70 coming-soon), 115 strand rows, 83 eligible, 62 distinct strand keys; ICAS Y5 Science `none`; language programmes ready (93/82/94/37 unique).
5. An empty bank always reads `unknown`. If every programme is later switched to enforce with nothing approved, the student would see "couldn't check" rather than "no content". The wrapper can separate those with the integrity report if you want it; I left it fail-closed.

## Test results
- `typecheck`: clean. `lint`: 0 errors (1 existing warning, `bar-model/index.ts:411`).
- `test`: **6,920 tests passed**, 397 of 398 files. The one failing file, `stripe-webhook-route.test.ts`, reads `.env.local`, which does not exist in this worktree (environment, not this change).
- `validate:questions`: all valid. `check:answers --include-published`: 0 failures, 1,571 warnings. `questions:validate-ledger`: pass.
- **Not run:** `build` (Turbopack rejects the `node_modules` junction in a worktree: "points out of the filesystem root"), `test:rls`, `test:e2e`, `test:e2e:auth` (need a local Supabase/browser setup that this host cannot run). CI will run these.

## UNVERIFIED
Strand rows under the floor are returned (state `none`) so P4 can say why; whether P4 shows or hides them is a design call.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)


## Update after review (commit 23d5d212)
- **Empty vs couldn't check (supersedes finding 5 and the fail-closed bullet):** a successful read that returns zero is `none`/`no_content`. Only a throw, an integrity problem or missing evidence is `unknown`. One test per path (`practice-studio-availability-paths.test.ts`).
- **Years:** the wrapper surfaces Year 3 and Year 5 only (supersedes finding 3).
- **Reported metrics:** each subject carries `duplicatesRemoved` and `sharedPromptStems` (same prompt, different content). Reported only; the de-dup key (prompt + passage + options + visuals) is unchanged.
- **Tripwire:** `practice-studio-no-live-amc-scholarship.test.ts` fails if any AMC-style or scholarship-style programme resolves to live. Promotion logic is untouched.
- 41 tests across the practice-studio files; typecheck and eslint clean on touched files. Full gate not re-run after this commit; CI will.
